claims.assertion: Yazhi says foreknowledge yields only a few possible futures because observation changes events; she therefore cannot predict outcomes with certainty.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says timelines are not fixed.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says humanity is a shared human role played by souls from many species, with Federation actors present in both Earth 3D and 5D.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says people cannot reach the game’s manager from within Earth; she proposes collective withdrawal from its rules as the only route.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She frames this as her solution.

proposed_topics.name: Humanity as a shared biological suit
